about_the_game:
Neuroshima Hex - Uranopolis




From beneath the earth, the sound of grinding metal echoes through the wasteland. Not beasts. Not plants. Not machines gone rogue. But humanity - reborn in steel and uranium.
Uranopolis is a mobile fortress-city, a relic of pre-war engineering and nuclear ambition. Its armies are few, but massive and nearly indestructible. Encased in thick armor and powered by unstable reactors. Uranopolis advances slowly but once it reaches its target - nothing can withstand its power.

Key Features:

⚡New Faction: Uranopolis - Take control of a heavily fortified faction built on nuclear technology.

⚡ "Energy" Mechanics – Manage energy from "power givers" to boost units or trigger devastating effects.

⚡Unmatched Durability - Crush enemies with slow but nearly unkillable units.

⚡New Unique Units - Deploy mechanical monstrosities, walking fortresses, and radiation-hardened engineers.
